data_scope: Published biological evidence and read-only research data only. No repo/code/design/doc edits, tests, annotation runs, or experiments.
primary_reading_note: All 12 verified cases have relevant primary methods/results read. Reading scopes and missing supplementary detail are individually recorded. Published experiments are author work; our actual independent data probes are limited to OarX.

Comparative table strain ATCC 13032 is distinct from experimental/genome strain ATCC 14067.
